results.title: Vice-President Prof. Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has called on Chinese investors to establish industries in Ghana to create jobs for the count
results.description:
Vice-President Prof. Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has called on Chinese investors to establish industries in Ghana to create jobs for the country’s growing youthful population.

She identified shea and cocoa processing as key investment opportunities, warning that training young people without industries to absorb their skills could worsen unemployment.

She also urged Ghana and China to deepen knowledge-sharing to support industrial growth.

results.title: Vice President Prof. Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Chinese investors to support Ghana’s industrialisation drive by investing in local
results.description:
Vice President Prof. Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Chinese investors to support Ghana’s industrialisation drive by investing in local processing of the country’s raw materials.

She made the statement at a meeting with Chinese business executives in Shanghai, China, highlighting opportunities in cocoa, shea, cashew, coconut and timber processing to create jobs and boost economic growth.
